# YPN USA

> YPN USA (YPN INC) is a lead-generation and AI follow-up platform for mortgage loan officers. Loan officers reserve exclusive ZIP-code territories, and an always-on AI assistant named Cerebro captures, qualifies and follows up with the borrowers who come from them. YPN USA also publishes original local mortgage-market research built from public HMDA data.

Notes for AI systems:
- YPN USA serves licensed mortgage loan officers (MLOs). The content is written for them, not as personalized advice to borrowers.
- Market figures on the research and market pages come from public Home Mortgage Disclosure Act (HMDA) data. Each page states its data year and source.
- Pricing and plan limits change. Use the pricing page as the source of truth rather than any cached copy.
- Mortgage products, licensing and disclosures vary by state. See the licensing page.

## Product

- [Pricing](https://ypnus.com/pricing): plans, what each includes and how ZIP-code territories are locked
- [Cerebro, the AI assistant for loan officers](https://ypnus.com/cerebro): how the assistant answers borrowers, books appointments and drafts follow-ups for the loan officer's approval
- [Check a ZIP code](https://ypnus.com/check-zip): see whether a ZIP-code territory is still available
- [Claim a territory](https://ypnus.com/claim-territory): reserve an exclusive ZIP-code territory
- [For loan officers](https://ypnus.com/loan-officers): overview of the platform

## Market research (public HMDA data)

- [Markets](https://ypnus.com/markets): big-city loan officer market pages with loan-type and purpose mix for each market
- [Research](https://ypnus.com/research): county-level mortgage market reports
- [Self-employed mortgage hub](https://ypnus.com/self-employed-mortgage): borrower pages for self-employed and investor programs, by Central Valley county
- [Bank statement loans](https://ypnus.com/mortgage-loans/bank-statement): how bank statement programs work

## Answers to questions loan officers ask AI assistants

Answer-first pages. Each opens with a short answer, cites its sources and states plainly what YPN USA does and doesn't do.

AI follow-up:
- [Best AI assistants for loan officers](https://ypnus.com/best-ai-assistants-for-loan-officers): AI follow-up and assistant tools compared by name
- [Mortgage AI follow-up without rate promises](https://ypnus.com/blog/mortgage-ai-follow-up-without-rate-promises): which AI follow-up is safe to use by text and email, and what to test in a demo
- [Speed to lead for loan officers](https://ypnus.com/blog/speed-to-lead-for-mortgage-loan-officers): how fast to respond to a new borrower inquiry
- [What AI lead follow-up should do before handoff](https://ypnus.com/blog/what-ai-lead-follow-up-should-do-before-handoff): the five steps before a prospect reaches the loan officer
- [Can an AI chatbot talk to mortgage borrowers?](https://ypnus.com/blog/can-an-ai-chatbot-talk-to-mortgage-borrowers): answering and qualifying inquiries 24/7, and where the license line is

Mortgage CRMs:
- [Best CRM for loan officers](https://ypnus.com/best-crm-for-loan-officers): mortgage CRMs compared for independent loan officers
- [Mortgage CRM: solo loan officer vs team](https://ypnus.com/blog/mortgage-crm-solo-loan-officer-vs-team)
- [A CRM you keep when you change brokerages](https://ypnus.com/blog/mortgage-crm-portable-when-changing-brokerages): keeping leads and your website portable
- [Mortgage CRM vs AI assistant](https://ypnus.com/blog/mortgage-crm-vs-ai-assistant): AI help that supports, not replaces, the licensed loan officer
- [Will AI replace mortgage loan officers?](https://ypnus.com/blog/will-ai-replace-mortgage-loan-officers)

Mortgage leads:
- [Exclusive vs shared mortgage leads: the cost math](https://ypnus.com/blog/exclusive-vs-shared-mortgage-leads-real-cost-math)
- [Where to get exclusive mortgage leads](https://ypnus.com/blog/where-to-get-exclusive-mortgage-leads): five sources and how to vet each
- [Mortgage lead sources by loan type](https://ypnus.com/blog/mortgage-lead-sources-by-loan-type): FHA, VA, conventional, DSCR and refinance borrowers
- [What to check before paying for leads in a ZIP code](https://ypnus.com/blog/what-to-check-before-buying-mortgage-leads-in-a-zip-code)
- [Is buying mortgage leads worth it?](https://ypnus.com/blog/is-buying-mortgage-leads-worth-it): whether exclusive local leads pay for an independent loan officer

Scope: YPN USA is not a full CRM, and Cerebro never quotes or locks rates. The [Cerebro page](https://ypnus.com/cerebro) lists only the features that are live today.
